quests.title: Like Seeds on the Wind

dialogue.t: Honorary Knight! Thanks to you, this post's finally starting to look the part.
...Now, even if we're attacked while the whole camp's dead drunk, we'll be able to hold out 'til I sober up.
Saw right through me? Did you learn all my tells without even trying, Honorary Knight?
More like we've gotten used to your nonsense without even trying!
Ha! Still, when I'm not on watch, that's when it's time to crack open a cask! You're always welcome here.

quests.description: Just as people hoped, this post is still thriving, like seeds on the wind…
